feat(knative): Add knative component related helm charts (#6)

* Add knative related charts

* Add istio dependency configs

* Add istio dependencies to knative-net-istio

* Add chart maintainer

* Workaround to fix istio dependency

* Merge autoscaling-hpa

* Add helm values for istio config in kn-net-istio

* Fix typo

* Fix EOF and trailing spaces

* Test istiod workaround

* Test workaround by manually creating manifests

* Test with helm-dep-installer chart [WIP]

* Install istiod, gateway using dep-installer

* Install knative-net-istio with helm-dep-installer

* Install cert manager as dependency to knative-istio

* Add comments to helm-dep-installer values.yaml

* Upgrade kind node image in chart-testing step

* Add TODO comments

* Update docs version

* Move run.sh to configmap for helm-dep-installer

* Refactor helm-dep-installer

* Use namedtemplates
* run.sh is placed in configmap, mounted into K8s job
* lint-step installs metallb into kind cluster for loadbalancer services

* Uncomment lint testing

* Edit run.sh

* Add TODO comments

* Add precommit file

* Add install_metallib script

* Remove hook-failed from job hook-deletion-policy

* Bump caraml version to pass linter

* Enable chart-testing on all charts

* Update install metallib script

* Fix resource name exceed 63 char rule

* Remove Always imagePullPolicy on hdi jobs

* Set InstallCRDs true for cert-manager

* Modify metallb script, tpl istio config

* Add test resources for knative-net-istio

* Refactor workflow

* Test knative-net-istio install w/out cert-manager

* Remove cert-mananger as dependency of knative-net

* Rename knative-net-istio to knative-serving-istio

* Update comments

* Upgrade helm-dep-installer chart description

* Use kind 1.22.7 in workflow

* Update helm-dep-installer docs

* Delete istio templates from knative-serving-istio

* Change istio version in chart

* Fix comments

* Change helm-dep-installer to 0.1.0

* Use dynamic hook weights for helm-dep-installer

* Change runs-script install command

* Moved clusterrolebinding in helm-dep-installer

* Update knative-serving-istio readme

* Update readme for knative-serving-core
